name: U-Boot Env & bootargs Builder
blurb: bootcmd and kernel bootargs built and explained, and the CRC'd environment image made
intro: Runs a pasted printenv the way U-Boot's shell would (run, setenv, if/else, &&/||, test, setexpr, loads, booti/bootz/bootm) and shows the boot path, the kernel command line argument by argument with where each one comes from, undefined variables, and the load addresses against the image sizes (overlaps, booti relocation, zImage decompression). It also builds the environment image as mkenvimage does (zlib CRC32 over the data area, 0xff padding) and the fw_env.config line.

inputs.label: printenv / fw_printenv
inputs.default:
baudrate=115200
board_name=EVK
boot_fit=no
bootcmd=mmc dev ${mmcdev}; if mmc rescan; then if run loadbootscript; then run bootscript; else if run loadimage; then run mmcboot; else run netboot; fi; fi; fi;
bootdelay=2
bootscript=echo Running bootscript from mmc ...; source
console=ttymxc1,115200
ethprime=FEC
fdt_addr=0x43000000
fdt_high=0xffffffffffffffff
fdtfile=imx8mm-evk.dtb
image=Image
initrd_addr=0x43800000
initrd_high=0xffffffffffffffff
ip_dyn=yes
jh_clk=
loadaddr=0x40480000
loadbootscript=fatload mmc ${mmcdev}:${mmcpart} ${loadaddr} ${script};
loadfdt=fatload mmc ${mmcdev}:${mmcpart} ${fdt_addr} ${fdtfile}
loadimage=fatload mmc ${mmcdev}:${mmcpart} ${loadaddr} ${image}
mmcargs=setenv bootargs ${jh_clk} console=${console} root=${mmcroot} ${optargs}
mmcautodetect=yes
mmcboot=echo Booting from mmc ...; run mmcargs; if test ${boot_fit} = yes || test ${boot_fit} = try; then bootm ${loadaddr}; else if run loadfdt; then booti ${loadaddr} - ${fdt_addr}; else echo WARN: Cannot load the DT; fi; fi;
mmcdev=1
mmcpart=1
mmcroot=/dev/mmcblk1p2 rootwait rw
netargs=setenv bootargs ${jh_clk} console=${console} root=/dev/nfs ip=dhcp nfsroot=${serverip}:${nfsroot},v3,tcp
netboot=echo Booting from net ...; run netargs; if test ${ip_dyn} = yes; then setenv get_cmd dhcp; else setenv get_cmd tftp; fi; ${get_cmd} ${loadaddr} ${image}; if test ${boot_fit} = yes || test ${boot_fit} = try; then bootm ${loadaddr}; else if ${get_cmd} ${fdt_addr} ${fdtfile}; then booti ${loadaddr} - ${fdt_addr}; else echo WARN: Cannot load the DT; fi; fi;
nfsroot=/srv/nfs/imx8mm
script=boot.scr
serial#=0b1a2c3d4e5f6071
soc_type=imx8mm
Environment size: 1622/16380 bytes

examples.title: i.MX6ULL RAUC A/B with bootz: DTB inside the decompressed kernel, redundant env on SPI-NOR

input.env:
BOOT_A_LEFT=3
BOOT_B_LEFT=3
baudrate=115200
bootcmd=run rauc_select; run boot_slot
bootdelay=0
boot_slot=run loadk && run loadfdt && run setargs && bootz ${kernel_addr_r} - ${fdt_addr_r}
fdt_addr_r=0x81000000
fdt_high=0xffffffff
fdtfile=imx6ull-gateway.dtb
kernel_addr_r=0x80800000
loadfdt=ext4load mmc 1:${rootpart} ${fdt_addr_r} /boot/${fdtfile}
loadk=ext4load mmc 1:${rootpart} ${kernel_addr_r} /boot/zImage
ramdisk_addr_r=0x83100000
rauc_select=if test ${BOOT_A_LEFT} -gt 0; then setexpr BOOT_A_LEFT ${BOOT_A_LEFT} - 1; setenv rauc_slot A; setenv rootpart 2; elif test ${BOOT_B_LEFT} -gt 0; then setexpr BOOT_B_LEFT ${BOOT_B_LEFT} - 1; setenv rauc_slot B; setenv rootpart 3; else echo No bootable slot; reset; fi; saveenv
setargs=setenv bootargs console=ttymxc0,115200 root=/dev/mmcblk1p${rootpart} rootfstype=ext4 ro rauc.slot=${rauc_slot} panic=5 quiet loglevel=7
soc_type=imx6ull

usage: Give env (printenv or fw_printenv text), optionally entry (the script to follow, default bootcmd) and picks to force if-branches ('mmcboot#1=else'), RAM start/size and the kernel/DT/initrd sizes for the load map, and env_size/redundant/env_dev/env_offset for the image. It returns the boot path table (each load, test and the boot command, expanded), the kernel command line with each argument's meaning and source variable, the load map with overlaps, undefined variables, the env CRC32 and used bytes, and texts: the command line, the mkenvimage input with the image's first bytes, and fw_env.config plus matching U-Boot CONFIG_ENV_* lines. Use it to explain or fix a board's boot environment, build bootargs, or make/check a uboot.env image.
sources: U-Boot docs: usage/cmd (run, setenv, test, setexpr, load, booti, bootz, bootm), usage/environment, tools/mkenvimage.c, include/env.h (env_t: crc, flags, data), lib/crc32.c (zlib CRC32)
U-Boot arch/arm/lib/image.c booti_setup() (2 MiB relocation), boot/image-fdt.c boot_relocate_fdt() (fdt_high)
libubootenv fw_env.config format; RAUC documentation (rauc.slot, integration with U-Boot)
NXP i.MX8M Mini EVK default environment (include/configs/imx8mm_evk.h) for the first example
